name: paperzilla
description: Find research digests, read papers, and search your Paperzilla feeds.

interface.longDescription: Find public research digests, read papers as Markdown, and search your Paperzilla project feeds. Sign in to connect your account. Public digests and catalog papers work without a project. Preparing missing Markdown is an explicit action; Paperzilla does not import missing papers or create projects through this integration.
defaultPrompt: Find public digests about machine learning.
Search my Paperzilla feed for new papers about retrieval.
Read the Markdown for this Paperzilla paper.
